seoTitle: Age Calculator – Find Your Exact Age in Years, Months & Days
metaDescription: Free online age calculator. Enter your date of birth and instantly find your exact age in years, months, days, and total days lived.
secondaryKeywords: how many days old am i
intro: Wonder exactly how old you are — down to the day? Our free age calculator gives you a precise answer in seconds: years, months, days, the total number of days you have been alive, and a countdown to your next birthday. Everything runs locally in your browser, so your date of birth never leaves your device.
whatIs: An age calculator is an online tool that measures the exact elapsed time between a person's date of birth and any target date — usually today. Unlike a simple year subtraction (2026 minus 1990 = 36), a proper age calculator accounts for leap years, the varying number of days in each calendar month (28, 29, 30, or 31), and whether the current month's birthday has already passed. The result is broken down into completed years, additional completed months, and remaining days, so you know your precise chronological age rather than just a rough whole-year estimate. Our tool also reports two bonus figures: the total cumulative days you have lived (useful for legal, medical, and milestone contexts) and the number of days remaining until your next birthday.
howToUse: Enter your date of birth in the 'Date of Birth' field using the date picker or by typing in YYYY-MM-DD format.
Optionally set a 'Target Date' if you want to calculate age as of a specific past or future date rather than today.
Read your exact age displayed as years, months, and days, plus the next-birthday countdown and the total days lived.
Use the copy button to copy the result to your clipboard, or press Reset to start over.
howItWorks: The algorithm resolves (Target Date minus Date of Birth) sequentially. First it counts how many full calendar years fit between the two dates, then how many additional full calendar months, and finally the remaining days. When the birth day-of-month is larger than the target day-of-month, the calculation borrows from the preceding month using that month's actual day count (28, 29, 30, or 31). Leap years — years divisible by 4, except centuries not divisible by 400 — are handled natively because the code works with JavaScript Date objects, which encode the Gregorian calendar's leap-year rules. Total days lived is computed as the integer part of (targetDate − birthDate) divided by 86 400 000 milliseconds. The next-birthday countdown finds the birthday occurrence in the current or following year and subtracts today's date.
workedExample: Example: Date of birth = 15 March 1990. Target date = 1 October 2026. Step 1 — count full years from 15 March 1990 to 15 March 2026 = 36 years. Step 2 — count full months from 15 March 2026 to 15 September 2026 = 6 months (the next full month, 15 October, exceeds the target). Step 3 — count remaining days from 15 September to 1 October = 16 days. Result: 36 years, 6 months, 16 days. Total days lived = floor((2026-10-01 − 1990-03-15) / 86 400 000) = 13 349 days. Next birthday (15 March 2027) is 165 days away from 1 October 2026.
resultInterpretation: The 'Years' figure is your completed age — the number that appears on official documents and legal forms. 'Months' is the count of additional full calendar months since your last birthday anniversary. 'Days' represents the remaining partial-month days after the last complete month. Together, these three numbers give your exact chronological age. 'Next Birthday' tells you how many days remain until you complete your next full year of life — handy for countdowns and milestone planning. 'Total Days' is the absolute day count from birth to target, which is particularly useful in medical contexts (neonatal age), scientific research (elapsed-time measurements), legal age-verification scenarios, and personal milestones like celebrating your 10 000th day alive.
useCases: Filling in age fields on applications and official forms where an exact years-months-days breakdown is required.
Calculating a child's precise developmental age for pediatric milestones or school-eligibility cut-off dates.
Determining whether someone meets a minimum-age requirement for a contract, driving licence, or pension.
Finding the age of historical events — for example, how long ago a famous building was constructed.
Personal curiosity: celebrating the 10 000th day of your life or planning a milestone birthday.
Computing your age at a specific past date, such as how old you were when you started a job or got married.
tipsAndLimitations: The calculator assumes the Gregorian calendar. Dates before the Gregorian reform (15 October 1582) may not be historically accurate.
For ages spanning the Julian-to-Gregorian calendar switch, consult a dedicated historical date tool.
Ensure your browser's local date and time are correct; the default 'today' value is taken from your device clock.
If you enter a date of birth in the future, the calculator will show an error — it cannot compute a negative age.
The 'Target Date' field is optional and defaults to today. Use it to calculate age at any past or future point.
All calculations run locally in your browser via JavaScript; no personal data is sent to any server.

faq.question: How old am I exactly right now?
faq.answer: Enter your date of birth in the calculator above and click 'Calculate'. You will instantly see your exact age in years, months, and days as of today, using your browser's local date and time.

faq.question: Does the calculator account for leap years?
faq.answer: Yes. The algorithm handles leap years fully. February 29 birthdays are treated as March 1 in non-leap years when computing the day count, which is consistent with most legal and medical standards worldwide.

faq.question: Can I calculate my age as of a past or future date?
faq.answer: Absolutely. Use the optional 'Target Date' field to set any date — past or future. This is useful for historical research, legal cut-off calculations, or projecting your age at a future milestone.

faq.question: How is 'Total Days' calculated?
faq.answer: Total days is the absolute number of days between your date of birth and the target date, computed as floor((targetDate − birthDate) / 86 400 000 milliseconds). Leap-day contributions are included automatically because the calculation uses actual calendar dates.

faq.question: Why does my age appear one day off sometimes?
faq.answer: This can happen if your browser's local clock is set to a different timezone than where you physically are, or if midnight has not yet passed in your timezone. The calculator uses your device's local date, so verify your system clock is accurate.

faq.question: What is 'Next Birthday' and how is it computed?
faq.answer: Next Birthday shows the number of days remaining until your next annual birthday. The tool finds your birthday's month-and-day in the current or following calendar year and subtracts today's date. If today is your birthday, it shows 0 or 365/366 days to the following year.

faq.question: Is this tool free and private?
faq.answer: Yes — fully free, no account needed, and completely private. Your date of birth never leaves your device. All calculations happen locally in your browser using JavaScript.

faq.question: Can I use this calculator on a smartphone or tablet?
faq.answer: Yes. The interface is fully responsive and works on all modern smartphones, tablets, and desktop browsers. The date picker adapts to touch-friendly inputs on mobile devices.
